testPolicy.text: Williams is truly test optional: it is entirely up to the applicant whether to submit SAT or ACT results. Applicants state on the Williams application whether they apply test-optional and may change their mind until the deadline of their decision program (QuestBridge Match, Early Decision, Regular Decision or Transfer).

cost.totalIncludes: published comprehensive fee total: tuition 76,300 + housing 9,830 + meals 9,490 + activities and residential house fees 340 = 95,960 (97,460 with the 1,500 study away fee). Not in that total: books estimated at 1,000 (covered by Williams for every aided student); CDS G5 adds transportation 850 and other expenses 1,850.

aidPromise.text: Williams meets 100% of demonstrated need with no loans and no work-study expectations, and offers free tuition to students whose families earn $200K or less (with typical assets); it covers the cost of books for every student on financial aid.

facts.text: For fall 2025, 964 students applied Early Decision and 256 were admitted, so about 27% of ED applicants got in versus 1,080 of the remaining 14,556 applicants (about 7%).
Williams offers free tuition to families earning $200,000 or less with typical assets, and its aid has no loans and no work-study expectation.
Williams offered 2,193 applicants a waiting-list place for fall 2025; 850 accepted and 25 were admitted.
Only one early round exists (binding Early Decision, November 15); Williams has no Early Action and no second ED round.
The 2026-27 comprehensive fee is $95,960, or $97,460 for students paying the $1,500 study away fee.

notes: williams.edu blocks curl and WebFetch (Cloudflare 403); the CDS PDF and admission pages were opened in Chrome (CDS mirrored at https://hub.williams.edu/institutional-research/files/2026/04/Williams-CDS-2025-2026-V2.pdf, listed on https://hub.williams.edu/institutional-research/common-data-set/). PDF not saved to .cache-raw (download blocked). C1: 7,368 men + 7,248 women + 904 unknown sex applied; 628 + 661 + 47 admitted; 286 + 279 + 2 enrolled. C1 residency breakdown is blank. CDS G1 already lists 2026-27 costs, matching the tuition page. The ED vs non-ED rates in facts are computed from C1 and C21 counts. The test-optional page gives no start date; Williams' need-blind status for international applicants was not found on the pages opened, so it is not claimed. No official fall 2026 counts found.
